name: Combat Rotation (Combat)
body:
You know when to relieve allies from combat by taking their place.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Initiative, base attack bonus +3.

Benefit(s): Once per round as a swift action, you may trade places with a willing ally within your reach and within reach of an enemy. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity against you or your ally.

This ability does not count against your maximum movement for the turn or as movement for your target.
